name: aave-markets-data
description: Fetch Aave market data using TypeScript SDK

scripts.ci: npm ci && npm run build && npm run prune && cd backend && npm ci && npm run build && npm run prune
scripts.ci:remote: npm run ci && npm run audit
scripts.ci:auto-fix: npm audit fix --omit=dev || true && npm --prefix backend audit fix --omit=dev || true
scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high >/tmp/_audit1 2>&1; head -1 /tmp/_audit1 | grep -qE '^found|^# npm audit report' || { cat /tmp/_audit1 >&2; exit 1; }; grep -oE 'GHSA-[a-z0-9-]+' /tmp/_audit1 | sort -u | grep -vE 'GHSA-848j-6mx2-7j84|GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx' | grep -q . && exit 1; npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate >/tmp/_audit2 2>&1; head -1 /tmp/_audit2 | grep -qE '^found|^# npm audit report' || { cat /tmp/_audit2 >&2; exit 1; }; grep -oE 'GHSA-[a-z0-9-]+' /tmp/_audit2 | sort -u | grep -vE 'GHSA-848j-6mx2-7j84|GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx' | grep -q . && exit 1; exit 0
scripts.prune: ts-prune -i '.*aave-shared-config/index\.d\.ts' 2>&1 | (grep -v '(used in module)' | grep -q . && exit 1 || exit 0)
